case_study_packaging.headline: Fresh food distributor unlocks $2.3 million in annual savings across eight indirect categories with Treya Partners
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: FreshEdge, a rapidly expanding fresh-food distributor backed by Wind Point Partners, had grown through a series of acquisitions that left procurement highly fragmented across more than 20 operating companies. Disparate systems, overlapping suppliers, and inconsistent contracts obscured visibility into roughly $25-33 million of indirect spend. To meet aggressive EBITDA improvement goals, leadership needed a coordinated sourcing effort that could quickly surface savings while standardizing purchasing processes.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A rapidly expanding multi-facility fresh-food distributor backed by the private equity ownership group had grown through a series of acquisitions that left procurement highly fragmented across more than 20 operating companies. Disparate systems, overlapping suppliers, and inconsistent contracts obscured visibility into roughly $25-33 million of indirect spend. To support operational efficiency and margin improvement goals, leadership needed a coordinated sourcing effort that could quickly surface savings while standardizing purchasing processes.
approach_summary: Conducted a comprehensive spend analysis covering $25M+ in indirect spend, normalizing thousands of AP records from 20 business units into a single, actionable view.
Ran a competitive RFP for corrugate, packaging, and labels, consolidating six legacy vendors down to two (Welch Packaging and Bunzl) and generating 27% savings on $5.7M of spend.
Leveraged the private equity sponsor’s national fuel card program to transition the fleet to Loves/Pilot, capturing $0.39M in annual savings while ensuring uninterrupted multi-state fuel access.
Brokered multi-year electric and gas supply contracts that locked in fixed rates and delivered 10% savings for initial sites, with additional utilities roll-outs in progress.
Renegotiated the incumbent Kamps pallet agreement, securing 15% savings and immediate EBITDA impact without requiring a supplier change.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya Partners identified and is driving $2.27 million in annual run-rate savings—nearly four times the client’s minimum $0.6 million target and more than a 7× return on Treya’s project fee. Beyond the financial impact, the engagement standardized MOUs, rationalized the supplier base, and gave leadership a clean, enterprise-wide view of indirect spend that can support future value-creation initiatives.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered the first executed savings contract within 90 days despite fragmented, multi-system data challenges.
Exceeded the guaranteed savings commitment by 4×, producing a 7× ROI on consulting fees.
Balanced disruption and speed by retaining incumbents where beneficial while consolidating spend for scale economies.
Provided PE-grade reporting and reusable contract templates that institutionalize procurement discipline for future sourcing waves.
